title: 管理員審核後台 → 真實數據串接 (前端)

commands: npm run lint — no new warnings/errors in admin/enrolments/page.tsx
findings: Replaced placeholder 'Module Under Development' with full data table wired to GET /api/admin/enrolments

Table columns: enrollee name+org+IA license, course name+ref+CPD hours, enrollment type (Individual/Group), payment method+receipt number, status badge (Pending/Verified/Rejected/Refunded), submitted date, actions
Status filter tabs: All / Pending / Verified / Rejected — each triggers API call with ?status= filter
Approve button: calls PATCH /api/admin/enrolments/[id] with action=APPROVE, shows success toast, optimistic UI update
Reject button: opens confirm dialog with enrolment summary + reason textarea, calls PATCH with action=REJECT + reason, shows warning toast
Payment proof preview: dialog modal with placeholder text (S3 presigned URL not yet available — shows ImageIcon + URL string)
Loading state: 5-row skeleton pulse animation with Loader2 spinner
Empty state: CheckCircle2 icon + contextual message per filter tab
Error state: AlertTriangle icon + error message + Retry button
Pagination: prev/next buttons with page info footer, appears only when totalPages > 1
Design tokens: follows existing admin page pattern (bg-[#f6f8f6], border-t-4 primary, font-serif headings, rounded-xs, 12px body text)
evidence.residual: Payment proof preview shows placeholder image icon + URL string — actual S3 presigned URL display deferred until S3 infra is available. Rejection reason stored in payerFullName (temporary).
